dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, ṣé o gbọ́ nínú ọ̀nà ìrẹ̀rí àwọn ọjọ́?
dialogue.translation: Excuse me, did you hear about the news of the day?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀, mọ́ gbọ́ tẹ̀nà. Ṣé kí o ṣé tán lọ́wọ́?
dialogue.translation: Yes, I heard about it. Have you done something about it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ẹ̀mi, dípé àwọn ọkùnrin ọlọ́kọ́ lọ́wọ́ kan tí ṣé tán pẹ̀lú àwọn ọkúnrin ọlọ́gèdè.
dialogue.translation: Well, the men on duty have already done something with the security men.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àwọn tí kí o sì jẹ́ àwọn tí ṣé obìnrin lọ́wọ́?
dialogue.translation: What about those who are women on duty?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Àwọn obìnrin wọ̀nyí sì jẹ́ àwọn tí wọ́n gbọ́ tán.
dialogue.translation: These women have already heard about it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Fún mi lọ́wọ́ kí n le ṣe ọ̀nà tí a fún wa.
dialogue.translation: Help me so I can do the thing we were given.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, mọ́ dúpé. Àwọn obìnrin kán sì ṣé tán pẹ̀lú àwọn ìrẹ̀rí tó dára.
dialogue.translation: Please, I am grateful. Some women have already done something good with the news.

dialogue.text: Mo n̄lówọ́ láti gbà n̄kan tó wà ní ọ̀nà rẹ̀.

dialogue.translation: I also heard from others that we can fix your device, but it didn’t work this way.

dialogue.text: Kú! Mo fún ọ n̄lá ọ̀nà lẹ́sẹ̀? Ṣe ẹ mọ̀ pé mo gbà ọ̀nà yìí?
dialogue.translation: Hello! Do I have a big path ahead of me? Do you know about this path?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dára! Mo mọ̀ pé ọ̀nà yìí dára pẹ̀lú. Tani ṣé ẹ yẹ̀ lọ́wọ́?
dialogue.translation: Fine! I know this path is good with effort. Who needs to do what?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo yẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ṣé ọ̀nà kíņ níi lẹ́sẹ̀. Mo fún ọ n̄lá ìpínlẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: I need to slowly make progress on this path. Do I have a big role?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni! ọ̀nà yìí dára pẹ̀lú ìmọ̀̀lẹ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀. Mo fún ọ n̄lá ìmọ̀̀lẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: Yes! This path is good with knowledge slowly. Do you have a big knowledge?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo mọ̀ pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà yìí. Mo ṣé ọ̀nà kíņ níi lẹ́sẹ̀. Ṣe ẹ gbà ìmọ̀̀lẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: I know about this path. I am making progress on it slowly. Do you have knowledge?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo gbà ìmọ̀̀lẹ̀ yẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọ̀nà. Mo fún ọ n̄lá ìpínlẹ̀ tán.
dialogue.translation: I have knowledge needed for this path. I assign you a big role now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dára! Mo yẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ṣé ọ̀nà dára. Mo mọ̀ pé o dára pẹ̀lú mọ̀.
dialogue.translation: Fine! I need to make this path good. I know you are good with knowledge.

key_phrases.phrase: Mo fún ọ n̄lá ọ̀nà lẹ́sẹ̀?
key_phrases.translation: Do I have a big path ahead of me?

key_phrases.phrase: Mo yẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ṣé ọ̀nà kíņ níi lẹ́sẹ̀.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo lẹ́ ṣé jẹ́ púpọ̀ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ bá mọ́ pé ẹ̀bùn tí mo wà nínú ẹbùn mi ṣé ni?
dialogue.translation: I still eat a lot on weekends if I notice that the food I have inside my fridge is enough?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Báwo ni o ma ṣé? Ṣé ọ̀nà tí o dúró sí lọ́wọ̀ rẹ̀ dára púpọ̀?
dialogue.translation: How do you do it? Is the way you stand still working very well for you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo wò lọ́wọ̀ mi nínú àwọn ọkàn mi, mo sì gba pé mo tún máa jẹ́ púpọ̀.
dialogue.translation: I look at my hands inside my heart, and I accept that I will eat a lot again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ohun tí o bá jẹ́ púpọ̀ lẹ́ kú fún ọ? Ṣé o ṣèlẹ̀ báwo láti máa jẹ́ púpọ̀?
dialogue.translation: What you eat too much will tire you out, right? So how do you continue to eat a lot?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo dá àkókò láti jẹ́ ẹ̀bùn mi, ṣéṣe ni ohun kan tí mo le ṣé láti máa wà ní ọkàn mi?
dialogue.translation: I make time to eat my food, so is there something I can do to always be in my mind?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí ẹni tí o ba jẹ́ àkókò kan tó, o le ṣé láti máa jẹ́ wẹ̀rẹ̀ wẹ̀rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: If someone eats at a time that is too much, they can do it to eat little by little.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé ṣèlẹ̀ ìṣè ẹ̀bùn-ìtànṣèn náà ni? Mo wà lẹ́yin rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: So is it the exercise of meal planning then? I am still behind you.

dialogue.translation: If I had put a lot of thought into it for them, it would have sounded clear carefully.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣé ẹ jọ̀wọ́ wọ́n gbatí rẹ̀ kíkó tí a fún yín?
dialogue.translation: Did you please tell them your thought that we gave you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀, mo fún wọn paapaá, ṣugbọn kíkó náà dún fúnfun lẹ́sẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I gave them some, but the thought also sounded clear carefully.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo ti mọ̀ pé kíkó rẹ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀ yẹ́ kúrò nínú rẹ̀, bí a bá ti ṣé kíkó lẹ́sẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: I know that your thought was carefully removed from you, if we had done thought carefully.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, ṣe kíkó rẹ̀ pàápàá lẹ́sẹ̀ lọ?
dialogue.translation: Please, is your thought entirely clear carefully?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀, mo fún wọn fúnfun inú kíkó rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I made it clear inside your thought.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ìwọ ṣé dáadáa, nítorí kíkó rẹ̀ dún fúnfun lẹ́sẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: You did well, because your thought sounded clear carefully.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, dúró! Mo fún ọ lórúkọ mi tí mo fẹ́ ṣé nkan. A ṣé pẹ̀lẹ́ kúrò nínú ẹ̀bùn mi?
dialogue.translation: Please, wait! I just gave you my name so I can do something. Did you just receive it from me?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí! Mo tún ri yìí ẹ̀bùn rẹ̀ dáradára. Ṣe mo lè fi ṣe rẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: Yes! I also saw this message of yours is good. Can I do it for you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ẹ̀yin, mo tún jẹ́ kí mo ṣe àyọ̀n se fún un. Ṣe mo lè tan lọ́wọ́ ọ̀nà mi?
dialogue.translation: You see, I also decided to change my mind about it. Can I finish with my plan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bí ọ̀nà yìí bá jẹ̀ àyọ̀n se fún ọ, ṣe mo lè fún ọ ìwọ̀n?
dialogue.translation: If this plan is good for you, can I give you my opinion?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Àyọ̀n se! Mo fé̩ri pé ó dára fún mi. Ṣe mo lè dúró títí mo ba fẹ́ fi ṣe nkan?
dialogue.translation: Great! I feel it is good for me. Can I wait until I want to do something?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jọ̀wọ́, mo dára pẹ̀lẹ́ fún ọ. Mu ẹ̀bùn mi kúrò nínú àyọ̀n se rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Please, I am fine with that for you. Take my message from your plan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Dúró! Mo tan fún ọ lọ́wọ́ ọ̀nà mi, ṣe o lè jẹ́ kí a ṣe rẹ̀ pẹ́?
dialogue.translation: Wait! I have finished with my plan, can you agree that we do it now?

key_phrases.phrase: Jọ̀wọ́, dúró!
key_phrases.translation: Please, wait!

key_phrases.phrase: Mo tún jẹ́ kí mo ṣe àyọ̀n se fún un.

key_phrases.phrase: Bí ọ̀nà yìí bá jẹ̀ àyọ̀n se fún ọ, ṣe mo lè fún ọ ìwọ̀n?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ̀ẹ̀, tí mo wà ní ilu yìí, mo fẹ́ gbọdọ̀ gba ẹ̀sẹ̀ gbogbo pẹ́ ní wayé yìí.
dialogue.translation: Yes, when I was in this city, I had to follow all customs like this.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Because of past experiences, we did everything like it was one day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Òun lọ́wọ́, nítorí yàtọ̀ ní àwọn àgbà ènìyàn kúrò ní ilu yìí.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, because of differences in the elders' practices here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé ó dára fún yín lọ́wọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀ oríṣiríṣi? Wà ní gbogbo ọjọ́.
dialogue.translation: Is it good for you to follow these traditions? They exist every day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kò, nítorí ẹ̀sẹ̀ tó wà kúrò ní ilu yìí jù lọ́wọ́.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé o mọ̀ pé àwọn ọkọ̀ tó dára púpọ̀ ni àwọn aṣọ̀ ìtọ́jú àti ọlọ́gbọ́n? Pẹ̀lẹ́, ṣe o le fún mi ní àkọ́sílẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: Do you know that cars that are very good are the ones that protect the environment and people? Please, can you give me some information?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: À! Mo mọ́ sílẹ̀. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́wọ̀ ọkọ̀ wọ̀n púpọ̀. Mo sì le fún ọ ní àwọn àkọ́sílẹ̀ tí ó dára. Ṣé o fẹ́ kí n ṣe ẹ̀kọ́?
dialogue.translation: Oh! I know a little. Cars have improved a lot. I can also give you good information. Do you want me to explain?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bí o ba fẹ́, jẹ̀ kí n sì gbọ́. Nígbà tí mo ba mọ̀ lọ́wọ̀ ìmọ́lẹ̀ tó ṣé, mo dúró lọ́wọ̀ ọkọ̀ tó dára.
dialogue.translation: If you want, let me also listen. When I understand how it works, I will wait for a good car.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ṣéyìn náà, mo pẹ̀pẹ́ lọ́wọ̀ ọkọ̀ tó dára púpọ̀. Àwọn ọkọ̀ tó wà ní ìlú wa kọ́ ni láti ṣe ẹ̀yìn gba àwọn ọkọ̀ tó dára.
dialogue.translation: Afterwards, I will also wait for a very good car. The cars we have in our city are not yet able to keep up with the good cars.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fé̩ tán. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ kí n ṣe ẹ̀yìn fún gbogbo àwọn ọkọ̀ tó dára. Ṣé o le ṣe ẹ̀kọ́ fún mi ní àwọn iyẹn?
dialogue.translation: I am tired. I will now start to look out for all the good cars. Can you teach me about these things?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pẹ̀lẹ́, mo le fún ọ ní àwọn ẹ̀kọ́. Ṣé o ba fún mi ní àwẹ́kọ́? Mo sì le fún ọ ní àwọn àkọ́sílẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Alright, I can give you some lessons. Do you have a device? I can also give you some information.

dialogue.speaker: Moderator
dialogue.text: Àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ̀, èmi kí yín ṣé àlàáfia fún ẹkún-ọjọ́ yìí. Bẹ̀rẹ̀, ṣé ẹ mọ́ ọ̀gbọ́n rẹ̀? Nítorí ẹ jẹ́ àwọn kí yín kí àwọn owó súnmọ́.
dialogue.translation: Everyone in the group, let me first greet you for this important meeting. First, do you know your colleagues? Because they are the ones who will implement the decisions.

dialogue.speaker: Person A
dialogue.text: Èmi bẹ̀rẹ̀ gbé ìdíjérẹ́ yìí sílẹ̀. Nítorí àwọn owó náà lè súnmọ́. Àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ̀ náà jẹ́ àgbá, ṣé àwọn yín mọ́?
dialogue.translation: I suggest we delay this project for now. Because the funds are weak. The team members are also seniors, do you understand?

dialogue.speaker: Person B
dialogue.text: Mo mọ́, ṣé ẹgbẹ́ télẹ̀ jẹ́ àgbá? Mo ní ìdíjérẹ́ yìí dún. Àwọn àgbá àwọn yín lè ṣé àṣiwẹ́wẹ́ funfun.
dialogue.translation: I understand. But should we decide immediately to proceed? I think this project is good. Your seniors can handle the challenges.

dialogue.speaker: Person A
dialogue.text: Nítorí nkọ́? Àwọn owó náà kò ti dé. Mo wà ní ìrẹ̀lẹ̀ láti mọ́ ọ̀gbọ́n rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Because what? The funds haven’t even arrived yet. I am here to know your colleagues.

dialogue.speaker: Person C
dialogue.text: Mo sì ṣé kí àwọn owó máa dé láti ìpínlẹ̀ ọ̀sọ̀. Àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ̀ kí yín ṣé àlàáfia fún ìdíjérẹ́ yìí.
dialogue.translation: I suggest that the funds should come from the treasury. Everyone in the group should agree on this project.

dialogue.speaker: Moderator
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ̀ yín jẹ́ àwọn kí yín ti ṣé àlàáfia fún ìdíjérẹ́ yìí. Mo fún yín ní ìdíjérẹ́.
dialogue.translation: Yes. Your group members are the ones who have agreed on this project. I give you the project.

key_phrases.phrase: Mo mọ́.
key_phrases.translation: I understand.

key_phrases.phrase: Nítorí nkọ́?
key_phrases.translation: Because what?

key_phrases.phrase: Àwọn ẹ̀gbẹ̀ yín jẹ́ àwọn kí yín ti ṣé àlàáfia.
key_phrases.translation: Your group members are the ones who have agreed.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo ti mọ Baba Kunle lẹ́sẹ̀ nígbà tí a ti ṣé àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ àgbẹ̀ lọ́dún yìí.
dialogue.translation: I only know Baba Kunle since we took the farming lessons this year.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pẹ̀lẹ́! Baba Kunle ṣé dára gan!
dialogue.translation: Okay! Baba Kunle is very good!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni! Oun kì yẹ̀ láti ṣé èrò ṣùgbọ́n oun ṣé dára púpọ̀.
dialogue.translation: Yes! He is not suitable for farming, but he is very good at something else.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo ti tan gbọ̀n pé Baba Kunle lọ́dún náà ṣé dára. Owó rẹ̀ n ṣé lẹ́nu.
dialogue.translation: I already know that Baba Kunle was also very good last year. His words are very pleasant.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ẹ̀yin mọ́ pẹ̀lẹ́ bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Baba Kunle kú méjì ni pé àwọn ẹ̀yìn rẹ̀ gbọ́dọ̀ máa ṣé ìwé.
dialogue.translation: You all know that too. Baba Kunle is very persuasive so his listeners must always listen to him.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni! Baba Kunle lọ́kàn tó dára nípa kí àwọn ènìyàn mọ́ mọ́nìyàn sì gbé e lọ́wọ́ àwọn ènìyàn.
dialogue.translation: Yes! Baba Kunle really knows how to make people understand and also helps people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mo fé kí ẹ̀yin ó máa bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti ṣé ìwé nípa Baba Kunle bẹ̀ẹ̀ ni.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Báwo ni o máa ṣe ilé-ìmọ̀ yìí? Lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú kọ́kọ́ ọ̀rọ̀ tí wọ́n fún àwọn ọmọdé?
dialogue.translation: How do you manage this school? With his effort and the teachers' diligent instruction?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Èmi kò mọ̀ bí bá n ṣe ilé-ìmọ̀ tó dára tó dára lọ́dúnà. Ṣe tani lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú?
dialogue.translation: I don't know how to run a better school than this. Who is behind his efforts with the teachers?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú rẹ̀ ni àwọn ọkọ́nrin tí a fún ní àwọn ìhà àgbègbè. Àwọn náà ní ọkàn wẹ̀rẹ̀wẹ̀rẹ́ pẹ́ láti ṣe àwọn ọrọ̀ tí ó pọ̀. Báwo ni a lè kó àwọn ọmọdé sí ọdún 2025?
dialogue.translation: His teachers are the men trained in various fields. They are very passionate about teaching. How can we prepare the students for 2025?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àwọn ọmọdé kò dúró ṣe ilera rẹ̀ kíkà. Àwọn ìsọ̀sọ̀nà àgbègbè kì í ṣe tó pọ̀ lọ́dúnà mi. Lọ́wọ́ ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú, àwọn ọmọdé lè dúró ṣe àmọ̀nà àgbègbè lọ́wọ́ ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú.
dialogue.translation: The students aren't staying up to their potential. The diverse curricula aren't very extensive in my opinion. With the teachers, students can remain focused on diverse subjects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Ṣe o kí ẹ̀kọ́ tó dára ṣe nkan tó dára? Tani lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ àwọn ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú láti ṣe àmọ̀nà àgbègbè?
dialogue.translation: Yes. Do you think good education is a good thing? Who alongside the teachers ensures diverse subjects are taught?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Àwọn ìsọ̀sọ̀nà àgbègbè àti àwọn ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú lọ́wọ́ àwọn ọmọdé ṣe àmọ̀nà àgbègbè. Àwọn ọmọdé sì gbọdọ̀ dúró gba àmọ̀nà kíkà lọ́dúnà kọ́kọ́.
dialogue.translation: The diverse curricula and teachers help students learn diverse subjects. Students must also remain committed to grasping various knowledge.

key_phrases.phrase: Báwo ni o máa ṣe ilé-ìmọ̀ yìí?
key_phrases.translation: How do you manage this school?

key_phrases.phrase: Àwọn ọkọ́nrẹ̀nnú rẹ̀ ni àwọn ọkọ́nrin tí a fún ní àwọn ìhà àgbègbè.
key_phrases.translation: His teachers are the men trained in various fields.

key_phrases.translation: With the teachers, students can remain focused on diverse subjects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ọmọ mi, ṣe àwọn ọkàn balẹ̀ lọ sí inú ilé? Mo gbọ́ dájú ni.
dialogue.translation: My child, did you all go inside the house? I heard it was urgent.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A lọ nẹ́, bẹ́ ẹ̀mi kò lè gbọ́ ní jẹ́ àwọn ilé dájú sì. Àwọn ọmọde dé níbẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: We went right now, but I couldn’t understand why the house was urgent. The children are there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ ẹ̀mi fún àwọn ọmọde ní àgbọ́n! Mo gbọ́ pé ilé tún dájú.
dialogue.translation: But did I give the children advice? I heard the house became urgent again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ àwọn ilé dájú fún èmi lọ́wọ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀, mo kò gbọ́ fún àwọn ọmọde ní àgbọ́n.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ṣé o wà ní jínà nígbà gbogbo? Mo dé ní 2 óbẹ̀. Jọ̀wọ́, tó mọ́ ní ńkán yẹ̀n, mú mi sórí rẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Do you always have your phone? I've been on it since 2 PM. Please, if you know anything about this, help me with it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo síi lọ sí i, ṣé o pàtàkù sì lojúú ní jínà rẹ̀? Ṣé ńkán yẹ̀n kọ́ ní ẹ̀tù sílẹ̀.

dialogue.text: Mo sí lojúú ní jínà, ṣẹ́lẹ̀ ńkán yẹ̀n làti ṣayẹ́nnú mi. Ṣé o lè ṣàkìsì sí mi níbẹ̀?
dialogue.translation: I was just looking at my phone, but that's not a big deal. Can you send a message to me there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mo sí lojúú ní ẹ̀tù sílẹ̀, ṣé o gbọ́dọ̀ ṣè tán? Mo ńkọ́ sí i níbẹ̀ tó dé.
dialogue.translation: I was just looking at the screen too much, do you have to do that? I'll do it when I get there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni! Jọ̀wọ́, ṣé o lè dájú tó máa ńlọ sí ẹ̀tù sílẹ̀? Jọ̀wọ́, mú mi lọ síbẹ̀.
dialogue.translation: Yes! Please, can you confirm if you will keep looking at the screen? Please, take me there.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: That's it, we've set the deadline for two weeks. I want you to confirm that the points we provided are correct.
